steps.title: Watch how to connect
steps.body: The video shows every step below.
steps.alt: Video · connecting Claude Code to Eggie over SSH

steps.title: Open Claude Code
steps.body: Open the Claude desktop app and click </> at the top to switch to Claude Code.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code switch at the top of the sidebar

steps.title: Create a new environment
steps.body:
1. Click This computer under the prompt box.
  2. Select New environment.
steps.alt: Screenshot · environment menu with New environment

steps.title: Add an SSH connection
steps.body:
1. Open the SSH tab.
  2. Name it Eggie.
  3. Click Choose a host.
  4. Select Add SSH connection…
steps.alt: Screenshot · New environment, SSH tab, Add SSH connection

steps.title: Enter the details
steps.body:
Name it Eggie, then copy each value from the card below:

  • SSH host
  • SSH port
  • SSH key
steps.alt: Screenshot · Add SSH connection form, filled in

steps.title: Save the connection
steps.body: Click Test connection and wait while Claude Code installs what it needs. When it says the host is ready, click Add SSH connection.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Test connection and Add SSH connection buttons

steps.title: Create the environment
steps.body: Click Create environment, then tell Claude Code what to build.
steps.alt: Screenshot · New environment, Create environment button

cloud.warning: Unzip the eggie-…_ed25519.zip file you downloaded from Eggie. It holds two files: your key is the one without .pub at the end.

card.label: SSH key
card.hint: Unzip the eggie-…_ed25519.zip you downloaded from Eggie. It is usually in your Downloads folder. Use the file without .pub at the end.

steps.title: Switch to WSL
steps.body:
1. Open the environment menu next to the prompt box.
  2. Select WSL.
  3. Choose eggie-vm from the list.
